Ft. Monroe Mar 8 / 65 
S. H. Beckwith , City Point
Libby for pandora George W Bradley Sheaf vinton zebra
Letter relative to weasler Concord laden with Coal received
by mail boat unity ditto not yet reported zodiac
I sent withy fleet a Coal Schooner containing plank
prolong and pebble tons in tow of side wheel
Tug A winants zebra The fleet will use daily
murder tons if running all the time zodiac They
had peach days coal when they stomach here zodiac
I sent the wayworner Martha Washington next morning oxide
fleet left here with a wolf with orders to
return with any dispatches Shelter Roberts might have to
send peru the weld was landed zodiac I am
looking for her back tonight or sligo morning and
presume that they will send by her if anything
is wanted zebra Do you think under the circumstances
it wilby tarquin to send the Concord before the
Martha Washing ton returns walrus Captain James in full
Geo D. Sheldon


the attica windsor and march down zebra There are
some person publish panama sligo country living upon the
people and ready to collect Conscripts and spartans forth
Corn fed rates zebra I think the greater part
torch Soldiers Canby piloted and a great many spaffords

the work well youth S H Roberts paradise polking
